mapper.sql: i.lambda_assignment_id, i.lambda_id, i.assignment_date, i.is_testing, i.end_date, i.deleted_at, i.location_id, b.dev_team_id, b.name, v.lambda_version_id, v.schedule, v.lambda_trigger, v.function_start_date, v.memory, v.timeout, v.is_public AS "lambda_version_published", v.latest_status AS "lambda_version_latest", h.status AS "lambda_version_status", h.arch, h.lambda_version, h.created_at, h.status_date, h.whatsnew
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lambda_assignments SET lambda_id = #{lambdaId}, location_id = #{locationId}, is_testing = #{testing}, assignment_date = #{assignmentDate}, end_date = #{endDate}
mapper.select: SELECT i.lambda_assignment_id, i.lambda_id, i.is_testing, i.assignment_date, i.location_id, i.end_date, i.deleted_at, b.lambda_id AS lambda_lambda_id, b.name AS lambda_name, b.description AS lambda_description, b.metadata AS lambda_metadata, b.dev_team_id AS lambda_dev_team_id, b.code_upload_id AS lambda_code_upload_id, b.created_at AS lambda_created_at, b.max_version AS lambda_max_version, b.max_sequence AS lambda_max_sequence FROM lambda_assignments i JOIN lambdas b ON b.lambda_id = i.lambda_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.lambda_assignment_id = #{lambdaAssignmentId}
SELECT lambda_assignment_id FROM lambda_assignments WHERE lambda_id = #{lambdaId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT lambda_assignment_id FROM lambda_assignments WHERE location_id = #{locationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM lambda_assignments i JOIN lambda_active_versions v ON v.lambda_id = i.lambda_id AND (NOT i.is_testing AND v.is_public OR i.is_testing AND v.latest_status = 1) JOIN lambda_versions h ON h.lambda_version_id = v.lambda_version_id JOIN lambdas b ON b.lambda_id = i.lambda_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.lambda_id = #{lambdaId} AND i.location_id = #{locationId} AND i.is_testing
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lambda_latest_runs SET lambda_assignment_id = #{lambdaAssignmentId}, invocation_lane = #{invocationLane}, lambda_version_id = #{lambdaVersionId}, function_name = #{functionName}, trigger_count = #{triggerCount}, pending_count = #{pendingCount}, next_input_number = #{nextInputNumber}, run_id = #{runId}, prev_run_id = #{prevRunId}, invocation_gen = #{invocationGen}, is_started = #{started}, aws_request_id = #{awsRequestId}, aws_log_stream = #{awsLogStream}, triggered_at = #{triggeredAt}, expiry_date = #{expiryDate}, aws_log_end_date = #{awsLogEndDate}
mapper.update: UPDATE lambda_latest_runs SET run_id = 0, triggered_at = NULL, expiry_date = NULL, invocation_gen = 0, is_started = false, pending_count = 0, next_input_number = NULL, aws_request_id = NULL, aws_log_stream = NULL WHERE lambda_assignment_id = #{lambdaAssignmentId}
